target_customer: Operations and product teams that run processes in spreadsheets
problem: Existing no-code tools do not scale for internal workflows, so operations teams go back to spreadsheets; Blitz offers a database plus forms, portals and logic without code.
product_category: No-code internal app and database platform

founders.name: Loic Veillard
founders.background_notes: Product manager and full-stack developer, freelance CTO and CPO (YC page)

founders.name: Clement Bruneau
founders.background_notes: Author of the YC launch post; one co-founder is described as second employee at Aircall and ex-PayFit product lead, not clear which

competitors.name: Airtable
competitors.what: Spreadsheet database that no-code tools build on
competitors.traction_then: Named in the YC launch post as a platform no-code tools build on

technical_complexity.rationale: A scalable data model with permissions and logic is real engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded no-code space with many funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Airtable acquired Internal.io and Airplane (shut down 2023 and 2024 per a search summary), showing incumbents absorbing smaller peers.

market_need_then: The launch post claims many no-code tools do not work for internal operations; no hard demand data.

branding.domain_note: blitznocode.com, a descriptive suffix on a common word, so the plain name was likely unavailable (inference, not sourced).

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name, confusable with many Blitz companies; no brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Blitz is listed active but the site still says the beta is coming soon with a 2025 footer, years after its 2022 launch. No verified funding or traction exists. No shutdown was found, and the shutdown stories in results concerned Internal.io, a different company.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights lists $0.5M seed 2022-09 (Y Combinator, Sharpstone Capital) and StartupIntros reports a $3M seed 2023-07 with angel Justin Mateen; aggregators only, not recorded as rounds. Education not found. Clement Bruneau's surname comes from the launch post author line. The Airtable reference was for Google Sheets and Airtable as platforms, so it is a weak competitor entry. Internal.io (founded 2019, shut 2023-12 per aggregator) was an earlier rival but undated sources, not listed.
